# 🔥 Wildfire Mod

Wildfire completely overhauls fire behavior in Minecraft.

## Features

- 🔥 Fire can spread to ANY block
- 💥 Fire can burn ANY block
- ⚡ Adjustable fire speed (1x → 50x)
- 🖥️ In-game config GUI
- 🌐 Multiplayer support (server-synced settings)

## Settings

- Spread To Any Block
- Fast Fire Jump
- Burn Any Block
- Fire Speed Slider (1x–50x)

## Multiplayer

Server controls all settings automatically.

## Controls

- Press **O** by default to open the settings menu

## Warning ⚠️

At high speeds (30x–50x), fire can spread extremely fast and may cause lag or destroy large areas quickly.
